column2: Paano mo pipiliin ang tamang orchestration pattern?
column4: I-analyze ang task complexity, coordination needs, at scalability requirements.

column2: Paano mo i-organize ang isang agent registry?
column4: I-categorize ang agents by capability, i-metadata ang strengths, at i-update regularly.

column2: Paano mo didistribute ang tasks sa multi-agent system?
column4: I-assess ang specialist capabilities at i-match sa task requirements.

column2: Paano mo i-handle ang communication failures sa pagitan ng agents?
column4: I-implement ang message queues at i-add ang retry mechanisms para sa reliable delivery.
